title: Projection of the localized currents converges to c[[B_1ⁿ]] (printed (10))
statement: Assume LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity and the statement (SPF) of iwl_smooth_pushforward (exact frozen Lean type, as an antecedent). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, τ : Fin n → ℝ^P orthonormal, Q := span τ, c, γ ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ γ < 3/4, p : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ continuous linear with p(y)_i = ⟪τ_i, y⟫, d with d(y) = ‖y − Σ_i ⟪τ_i, y⟫ τ_i‖, W′ := {y : ‖p(y)‖ < 1, d(y) < 3/4}, V := B_1(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ and e := (e_1,…,e_n), e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Let Z_k ∈ D_n(W′) (k ∈ ℕ) be integer multiplicity with spt Z_k ⊆ {d ≤ γ}, sup_k (M(Z_k) + M(∂Z_k)) < ∞ (masses on W′) and Z_k(ω) → c∫_Q ω(z)(τ) dHⁿ(z) for every ω ∈ D^n(W′), and let S ∈ D_n(V) satisfy S(ω) = c∫_V ω(x)(e) dx for every ω ∈ D^n(V). Then there are integer multiplicity S′_k ∈ D_n(V) with sup_k (M_{W″}(S′_k) + M_{W″}(∂S′_k)) < ∞ for every W″ ⊂⊂ V, and S′_k ⇀ S in V.
